mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_commission_detail (openid, from_openid, order_no, pay_amount, commission_amount, transfer_time) VALUES (#{openid}, #{fromOpenid}, #{orderNo}, #{payAmount}, #{commissionAmount}, #{transferTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, openid, from_openid, order_no, pay_amount, commission_amount, create_time, transfer_time FROM t_commission_detail WHERE openid = #{openid} AND order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission_amount), 0) FROM t_commission_detail WHERE openid = #{openid} AND transfer_time IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission_amount), 0) FROM t_commission_detail WHERE openid = #{openid} AND transfer_time IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_commission_detail WHERE openid = #{openid} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
